verdict.rationale: n8n documents a Webhook trigger node, and a community user confirms the Kafka trigger node exists (while criticizing its docs). Another user reports a non-programmer building webhook-initiated tasks, and n8n advertises 1500+ app integrations. Together this shows event-driven triggering from connected apps is a core capability. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of app-specific triggers for new records, incoming messages, new emails, and form submissions; documentation depth for trigger nodes beyond Webhook (one user notes the Kafka trigger page is empty).
